title: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: An artificial gorgon made by the Theorist who is torn between her duty and her real friends, and who tries to learn what overwriting the Multiverse will mean.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: A fragmented, clinical version of Jace who runs the Echoverse from his sanctum and tries to kill Jadzi but fails.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker held captive in a hexed cell where nothing dead can be reanimated, who tells Tam that overwriting will suffocate the original Multiverse.

entities.name: Professor Opal
entities.description: The Echoverse's version of Liliana, a healer and snob who is Liliana's jailer and says she will overwrite her.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle held captive whose mind shows the Theorist an implosion of possibilities and who dares him to kill her.

entities.name: Echoverse Chandra
entities.description: A blue-goggled cryomancer version of Chandra who mentored Tam and is a colleague of the Theorist.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A friend who appears to Tam in visions, bitter that half-people win while real ones die.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin friend of Tam, to whom she writes and then burns a letter.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The original planeswalker mind-mage of whom the Theorist and Tam are parts.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A figure whose oversize stone bust sits in Liliana's cell.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A figure who appears in the Theorist's vision of possible futures.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: Someone the Theorist wishes were present to help contain the map of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A figure whose eyes Liliana says Jace will see with.

entities.name: Laurier
entities.description: An academic whose thesis Tam cites about weaving Multiverses together.

entities.name: The Echoverse
entities.description: The Theorist's unstable replacement Multiverse, which blooms on its own.

entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: A tower academy where cadets are quiet and gravity is fluid.

entities.name: The Sanctum
entities.description: The Theorist's mage-ring-lined chamber at the top of the tower.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The original school Tam attended, flat and noisy.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A punishing plane the Theorist sends Tam to record.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: A plane whose birth from two colliding planes the Theorist wants to witness.

entities.name: Theorix
entities.description: The Hexhaven school of Tam's dormitory.

events.summary: Tam, lonely in her hexed dormitory, writes a letter of apology and warning to Abigale and burns it.
events.quote: The letter ignites quickly, quietly, and burns easily in the waste bin.

events.summary: In her cell, Liliana fails to kill a mouse and cannot use her necromancy.
events.quote: "Die," she wills, but the intruder merely pauses to clean his whiskers.

events.summary: Professor Opal, Liliana's double, taunts her about being overwritten and offers to save her; Liliana's heart seizes.
events.quote: "Do you wonder what it will be like? Me overwriting you?"

events.summary: Opal calls off the heart attack and says Liliana will fade away like cottonwood fluff, and Liliana refuses to give up her pain.
Tam visits Liliana, who asks if Jace is her father or boyfriend, and Tam takes her to see the orrery.
events.quote: Tam unlocks the bars, walks to the wood and stone sphere, and holds up a hand.

events.summary: Tam shows Liliana the orrery copy and asks what overwriting will mean; Liliana explains it will suffocate the original Multiverse.
events.quote: "It won't tear them apart, but layering one Multiverse on another will smother the souls of everyone in the original.

events.summary: Liliana tells Tam that she has the best parts of Jace and asks her to tell Jace not to keep a woman in a dungeon.
events.quote: "From what I can tell, the best parts of himself."

events.summary: Tam passes Chandra in the tower and sees Lluwen's vision resentfully remark about half people.
events.quote: Why do these half people get to win when the real ones have to die?"

events.summary: Tam confronts the Theorist with her feelings; he silences her with a command and then hugs her.
events.quote: The Theorist flinches, lip curling like he slugged back a bitter liquor.

events.summary: The Theorist tells Tam to purge herself of doubt as he does.
events.quote: "Then purge yourself of doubt," he says

events.summary: The Theorist sends Tam to Innistrad through an Omenpath to record its planar data.
events.quote: "Go to Innistrad. I need its planar dimensions, including extraplanetary bodies.

events.summary: The Theorist goes to Jadzi's cell intending to kill her himself.
events.quote: Jadzi, the oracle, awaits with a straight back and a combative glare.

events.summary: He dives into Jadzi's mind and drowns in countless possible futures.
events.quote: The Theorist's eyes burn bright. He dives into the oracle's mind and crashes into an absolute mess.

events.summary: Jadzi sees his future and the Theorist lowers his hand, failing to kill her.
events.quote: The Theorist sees in Jadzi's mind a single image—himself, dropping his hand—and she sees him see it in turn.

events.summary: Jadzi taunts him and he storms out.
events.quote: The Theorist turns, embarrassed, furious, and slams the cell door behind him.

relations.note: Opal is Liliana's jailer and plans to overwrite her.
relations.quote: In this world, her double is Professor Opal, and in this world Professor Opal is dreadful.

relations.note: Jace created Tam as a person with his chin, stance and talents.
relations.quote: so much of her is just him

relations.note: He calls her Tamira and teaches her.
Liliana calls the Theorist her ex.
relations.quote: "Tell my ex it's a bad look to keep a woman locked in a dungeon.

relations.note: Tam remembers her as her cryomancer mentor.
relations.quote: her cryomancer mentor always took the time to explain how and why something was the way it was
